invariants: Every installed expert remains subject to deterministic package admission and security scanning.
Immutable generation integrity is distinct from admission and source trust.
Source trust is distinct from runtime readiness.
Skills admission never grants execution authorization.
External tool declarations inside a Skill do not bypass host/user approval or execution authority.
Unknown external sources are never implicitly trusted or redistributable.
External curated design sources have auto_mutation disabled.
Workspace/user-specific design history must not cross member boundaries.
License and redistribution decisions come from registry/trust-policy.json and cannot be overridden by Interface Designer routing.
